principle: A file named benchmark is not automatically a Premium-safe reference. Reuse patterns, not legacy defects.

banFromPremium: continuous signal wobbleX/wobbleY driven by Math.sin/Math.cos
sources.reason: Contains continuous undirected micro-motion that conflicts with Gold camera/motion non-regression and lowers perceived production stability.

banFromPremium: background radial-gradient shift driven by Math.sin(frame)
large BEFORE/AFTER panel blocks as default visual grammar
sources.reason: Useful timing reference, but its ambient wobble and panel-heavy comparison language are not Premium-safe production grammar.

upgradeForPremium: replace overlay shelf dominance with scene-integrated spatial hierarchy where possible
tie pulses to causal scene events rather than decorative emphasis
carry brand motif through scene materials and motion, not only typography
sources.reason: Contains strong editorial timing patterns, but should be used as a rhythm source rather than copied as a final visual layer.
